newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise Sept rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise Sept rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday that it would raise the margin requirement on its September rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Thursday.
This will bring the total margin requirement on the September contract to 157,750 yen.
The move aims to cool overheated trade.
Margin fees on the October contract will remain unchanged at 62,500 yen, and the fees on the other contracts will also be unchanged, at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
